name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: The angler at Birchpool's weight is immediately next to the angler using the Wobbler.
Gus, Wobbler, and 5 lb belong to different catches.
Wade's weight is higher than both the angler at Birchpool and the angler fishing with Maggot.
The angler at Pinehollow's weight is immediately below the angler fishing with Shrimp.
The angler using the Popper has a higher weight than the angler at Pinehollow.
